website.tagline: FactoryOps — machine states, downtime, and energy as assets
website.description: Guidewheel reads the electrical heartbeat of factory machines through clip-on current sensors and derives run/idle/down states, cycles, energy, and operator-tagged downtime issues. Connect a tenant to pin machines and downtime issues as assets, read states, uptime, energy and production actuals — and write back issues, production entries and scrap to close the loop with an ERP or CMMS.
useCases: Pin a machine and read its run/idle/down state over a shift
Turn a downtime issue into an ERP/CMMS action and write the reference back
Reconcile production actuals, scrap and energy per shift into reports
Compute OEE from uptime and production entries — there is no OEE endpoint

provider.contextMessage: You have access to Guidewheel (FactoryOps) — machine run/idle/down states, downtime issues, production, scrap and energy, all sensed from clip-on current transducers on each machine's power line. Timestamps are unix epoch milliseconds (from_ts/to_ts); a few endpoints accept ISO 8601 instead, so if a range parameter is rejected, try the other form. The API is pull-only — there are no webhooks — and it is rate limited to 1000 calls per day and 50 per minute per tenant, so prefer one wide time-range read over many narrow ones and keep any polling loop modest. There is no computed-OEE endpoint: derive OEE from uptime, production entries and scrap. Issues are the only fully read-write entity, which makes them the synchronization point with a CMMS or ERP — attach a work-order number with guidewheel_update_issue. Response field names vary by tenant configuration and Guidewheel distributes the field-level guide on request, so every read tool takes a passthrough `query` object, every write tool takes a passthrough `fields` object, and guidewheel_api_get will probe any path under /api/v1 when a documented parameter does not match.
provider.instructionText: Enter the tenant base URL and API key issued by Guidewheel. Both arrive together when Guidewheel provisions API access for your company — there is no self-serve developer portal. Sandbox tenants are available on request.
